tutorial.label: What's New in Chipmunk
tutorial.description:
This panel describes some of the new features and behavior changes included in this update.

To open this panel again later, select Help > What's New in Android Studio from the main menu.

stepElement.section:
Inspect and debug composable animations created with the animatedVisibility API in Animation Preview. Animation Preview allows you to see each animated value at a given time and ensure that your animation is choreographed properly.


Learn more

You can now deploy composable previews from library modules to an emulator or physical device. Composable previews allow you to view your UI within Android Studio without having to run your app on a configured test device.


Learn more

step.label: Detect jank on Android 12 and higher

stepElement.section:
Identify sources of slow UI rendering by using the Janky Frames track in the CPU Profiler tool. The Janky Frames track by default shows only janky frames as candidates for investigation, so you can quickly hone in where the problem is.


Learn more

step.label: Jetifier warning and check in Build Analyzer

stepElement.section:
To speed up builds, Build Analyzer now displays a warning if your project's gradle.properties file includes android.enableJetifier=true. If you see this warning, you can run a check within Build Analyzer to confirm if the flag can be removed, for improved performance.


Learn more

Android Studio now supports both Android and Java test fixtures, so you can run tests in a consistent and efficient manner.


Learn more
